expected.image:
A calm vertical poster for a local library's summer reading program, with a window-side reading table and stacked books.

## Table scene
reading table — A pale oak reading table stands beside a tall window, with an open book and a short stack of closed books near its edge.
book stack — The stacked books lean slightly, and their cloth spines show muted green and cream.

## Color
warm cream and sage — The poster uses a warm cream ground with sage-green accents that pick up the green of the book spines.
print design — The layout is a clean vertical print design with plain flat areas and generous empty space around the table.

## Light
soft window light — Soft natural daylight enters from the window at the left, lays pale highlights along the book edges and drops gentle shadows toward the right.

## Camera
framing — A straight-on vertical frame at table height, with the table filling the lower half and the window filling the upper half.
expected.video: A library window with a stack of books and a summer reading sign. The camera gently moves from the sign toward the books as sunlight shifts across the table, ending on the open book with continuous motion and a calm welcoming mood.
